metadata.description: FezaPlugin: 40 documentation and design skills for software teams across requirements, project management, HCI/UX, software quality assurance and a cross-package toolkit.

plugins.name: feza-requirements
plugins.description: Requirements engineering skills: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 aligned SRS generation and review, elicitation kits, requirement classification, conflict analysis and user stories.

plugins.name: feza-pm
plugins.description: Project management skills: scope statement, WBS, PERT estimation, budget, CPM scheduling, risk register, RACI, SWOT, stakeholder and communication planning.

plugins.name: feza-hci
plugins.description: Human-computer interaction skills: holistic UX review, heuristic evaluation, usability test planning, cognitive load, color and contrast audit, design thinking, prototyping, personas, and HCI-compliant UI design and implementation.

plugins.name: feza-sqa
plugins.description: Software quality assurance skills: IEEE 730 SQA plan, test plan, metrics plan, IEEE 1028 inspection, traceability matrix, change control and defect reporting.

plugins.name: feza-toolkit
plugins.description: Cross-package utilities: brief clarification interview, skill menu, lifecycle model selection, full documentation package orchestration, demo script and bilingual glossary. full-package requires all FezaPlugin packages.
